ITA-9.8.9 vayasthāpanam वयस्थापनम्
Rejuvention therapy for healthy ageing
Rejuvenation therapy or medicines beneficial for prolonging youth and preventing senile changes in the body.

vāyavyarogaḥ वायव्यरोगः
Diseases caused by vata
A disease caused by vitiation of vata in the body such as arthritis, sciatica or paralysis.

ITA-1.9.3.1.4 vāyuḥ वायुः
Air element
Responsible for movement, acts as the substratum of touch perceived by skin.

.38 vāyumārgaḥ, anilāyanam वायुमार्गः, अनिलायनम्
Respiratory passages
